title: Big O in 60 seconds
caption: Big O notation in 60 seconds: how programmers describe what happens to code as the input gets huge. #programming #algorithms #coding

scenes.title: Big O
scenes.say: Fast on ten items. On a million, it takes all week.
Code that's instant on ten items can crawl on ten million. Big O describes how it grows.

items.title: O(1)
items.say: O of one: same time, however big. Like a hash lookup.

items.title: O(n)
items.text: twice the data, twice the time
items.say: O of n: double the data, double the time. Like scanning a list.

items.title: O(n²)
items.say: O of n squared: double the data, four times the time. Like comparing every pair.

scenes.say: At a million items, the difference is twenty steps or a trillion.
That's Big O. Not how fast, but how it grows.
